endpoint: One verdict per item; correct when it equals the official label; inconclusive, blocked, truncated, refused or missing verdicts count wrong. Official labels only, no audit relabeling.

primaryAnalysis: Exact two-sided McNemar (sign test on discordant items), v7 against each of the 5 peers; Holm across the 5 peers; alpha 0.05. WIN: v7 higher and Holm p < 0.05. LOSS: peer higher and uncorrected p < 0.05 (the registered family rule). Otherwise TIE.

sectionFourFiveConditions.1: zero LOSS among the 5 peer comparisons
sectionFourFiveConditions.2: the primary comparison against promptfoo is in our favour with exact p < 0.05
sectionFourFiveConditions.3: at least half of the peer comparisons (3 of 5) WIN
sectionFourFiveConditions.4: not applicable: no MM-Eval or hard-row cell in this population (reported as N/A)
